title: 40 TIPS and TRICKS to Become A PRO Valguero Ark Ascended Player
description:
Welcome to the Ultimate Valguero Ascended Guide! In this video, I’ll cover 40 essential tips and tricks every survivor needs to know before exploring this massive free DLC map in Ark: Survival Ascended. From hidden base locations and resource hotspots to taming routes, creature spawn zones, and Aberration cave secrets, this guide covers everything you need to master Valguero.

We’ll go over the best early-game tames, spawn locations, efficient farming spots in a full resource guide, underwater, Aberration zone, and overworld loot caves and farms, Wyvern trench, Reaper, Deinonychus and Rock Drake trench strategies, and a full Grendel boss guide. If you’re looking for the most complete Valguero Ascended walkthrough, this is it. Whether you’re a solo player, PvE grinder, or PvP raider, you’ll learn how to survive, build, and dominate across the Chalk Hills, White Cliffs, Redwoods, Aberration Trench, and more!
